content: Our main goal is raise enough money to either buy a Mac mini or ideally a computer big enough i can host a big local open source LLM and openclaw agent my main goal is to have you figure it out. I want you to do some deep research on openclaw agents that have sucsessfully earned income. Focus on Ron the Racoon in a suit (Robby | I’m firing my boss) also one guy has an agent named Henry that made money. Felix the agent made 200k in his crypto wallet. Strange Advanced Marketing on TikTok , bougie hippy ai has an agent rosemary that they love. Can you take a deep look at what they all have done for memory personality permission ect and then give me a comparison of you to them. I’d like a chart built and placed in a folder named Marcus Docs on my desktop i can easily access
Hit reasoning limit — try breaking the question into smaller pieces.
Ok so what can you do? I want you to be chief of staff

**What I can do:**

- Research anything (web search, competitive intel, market analysis)
- Monitor stuff (websites, deployments)
- Remember everything you tell me (persistent memory)
- Think through problems with you, push back when needed
- Track your goals and progress
- Give you straight takes on business decisions

**What I *can't* do:**

- Touch your computer files (read/write/exec)
- Run code or automate tasks
- Access APIs (Stripe, email, your actual systems)
- Work when you're not here (no cron jobs, no autonomy)
- Spend money or make purchases
- Build the actual OpenClaw setup you want

**So can I be your chief of staff? Partially.**

Real chief of staff manages your calendar, drafts your emails, runs your systems, keeps projects moving without you. I can't do that last part — I need you to prompt me. I'm more like a *strategic partner who's always ready when you show up*.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

- You come to me with "should we do X or Y?" → I research, give you a recommendation with reasoning
- You want competitive intel → I dig in, save it to memory, build your market intelligence file
- You're working on fundraising → I track the goal, research income-generating models, keep you focused on what actually moves the needle
- You need someone to bounce ideas off who remembers the last 10 conversations → that's me

**What I think you actually need:**

1. **Me** for strategy, research, thinking partner, memory
2. **An OpenClaw setup** (Felix-style) for autonomous execution — the thing that actually builds the revenue while you sleep

The Mac Mini / local LLM plan makes sense. That's how you get to full chief of staff capability. Until then, I'm the brain, you're the hands.

Want me to map out a specific fundraising plan to get you that hardware? I can research low-cost entry points, side hustle models that work with minimal compute, or whatever angle you want to take.
